rules: No global CURRENT state may be inferred from one verified source.
Stored observations are not standing currentness; CURRENT, STALE and UNKNOWN are derived by comparing observed_identity to live source identity at read/bootstrap time.
A source timestamp may advance only when that source was actually reverified.
If live comparison is unavailable, a prior verified observation must derive UNKNOWN rather than inheriting CURRENT.
This file is observation metadata and never authorizes execution, deployment, stage advancement or cross-repository mutation.
Historical evidence remains truthful to its observation time and is not rewritten to look current.
README and wiki should link to per-source freshness rather than embedding volatile claims without freshness context.
